known_corrections: Lemma 3.2 (p.4) is prefaced 'It is clear that' and has NO PRINTED PROOF anywhere in the 16 pages. Do not attribute any mechanism to 'the proof of Lemma 3.2(1)'.

The tie-collapse (coincident witnesses merge to one slot whose type is the CONJUNCTION of the tied types) is FORCED BY Definition 3.1 (p.4): the witness chain is strict (xn > ... > x0) and the pinning indices i0..im in {0..n} carry no distinctness requirement. Corroborated by the k=m case split (p.7) and Def 7.5 (p.13).
Mandated citation form: 'the construction forced by Def 3.1 (p.4), corroborated by the k=m split (p.7) and Def 7.5 (p.13); Lemma 3.2(1) (p.4) states the closure without printed proof.'
Def 7.5 (p.13) is NOT a half-open interval restriction; it is a 3-alternative definition including z0 > z1 and z0 = z1.
